questions.question: 5 men and 8 women can complete a task in 34 days, whereas 4 men and 18 women can complete the same task in 28 days. In how many days can the same task be completed by 3 men and 5 women?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

5 men and 8 women can complete a task = 34 days

4 men and 18 women can complete the same task = 28 days

**Formula:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let efficiency of 1 man and 1 woman be x and y respectively, then

(5x + 8y) × 34 = (4x + 18y) × 28

⇒ (5x + 8y) × 17 = (4x + 18y) 14

⇒ 85x + 136y = 56x + 252y

⇒ 85x - 56x = 252y - 136y

⇒ 29x = 116y

⇒ x/y = 116/29

⇒ x : y = 4 : 1

Total work = (5 × 4 + 8 × 1) × 34

Total work = (20 + 8) × 34

Total work = 28 × 34

Efficiency of 3 men and 5 women in 1 day = (3 × 4 + 5 × 1) = 12 + 5 = 17

∴ Time taken by 3 men and 5 women to complete the whole work = (28 × 34)/17 = 56 days

questions.question: Which of the following eye disorders is known as ‘lazy eye’?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Amblyopia.**__

__
 
• **Amblyopia: Also known as Lazy eye.**

 
 
• It represents a type of **muscular defect of the eyes** that causes a loss of vision due to muscle imbalance.
 
• It leads to** double vision. **
 
• The brain tries to repress the vision in one eye, resulting in loss of sight to the unused eye.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Presbyopia:**

 
 
• Decreases the power of accommodation and can be corrected by using bi-focal lenses.
 
 
 
• **Hypermetropia:**
 
 
• The focal length of the eye lens is too long and can be corrected by the convex lens of suitable power.
 
 
 
• **Myopia:**
 
 
• Also known as near-sightedness.
 
• The far point is nearer than infinity.
 
• A person with this defect can see nearby objects but cannot see distant objects distinctly.
 
• Image of the distant object is formed in front of the retina.
 
• Arise due to - (a) excessive curvature of the eye lens, (b) elongation of the eyeball.
 
• Correction - concave lens of suitable power.

questions.question: Which river originates from Tibet and enters India through Arunachal Pradesh?
questions.solution:

__
 
• The Brahmaputra River originates from the** Angsi Glacier in Tibet** which is an is an autonomous region of China.
 
• It is knowns as Tsangpo__ in Tibet.
 
• It flows eastwards parallel to the Himalayas. 
 
• On reaching the** Namcha Barwa (7757 m)**, it takes a **‘U’ turn and enters India in Arunachal Pradesh **through a gorge.
 
• Here, it is called the **Dihang** and it is joined by the Dibang, the Lohit, and many other tributaries to form the Brahmaputra in Assam.
 
• The river flows for about 3,848 km (2,391 mi) long which makes it the world's 15th Longe**st river.**
 
• Majuli Island is the first island to be made a district in India between the channels of the Brahmputra river is the largest river island in the world.
 
• The Brahmputra river forms the world's largest and the deepest canyon, Yarlung Tsangpo Grand Canyon while leaving the Tibetan Plateau.
